title: SAM 3 Sees More Than It Detects: Promptable Concept Maps Beyond Categories
abstract: arXiv:2611.25747v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Promptable segmenters answer what a thing is. Dense prediction tasks also ask class-agnostic questions, such as what stands out or hides, how light is blocked, transmitted or reflected, and where structure lies. Robots, surveillance systems and image editors build on their answers. We study promptable concept maps (PCM), which extend SAM 3's promptable concept segmentation from noun instances to maps of concepts named by short noun phrases such as `"transparent object", with "none" as an answer. PCM-Bench groups the standard test sets of seven such tasks by the question they ask. On it, we find that SAM 3 sees more than it detects. Its semantic path responds to many of these concepts, yet a low image-level presence score can block every detection of its instance path. We present UNVEIL, which trains a copy of SAM 3's semantic path for these maps, with LoRA on copies of its last blocks. A separate presence decoder learns from verified n

translated_title: SAM 3 看到的比它检测到的更多：超越类别的可提示概念图
translated_abstract: 可提示分割器回答“这个东西是什么”，而密集预测任务还会提出与类别无关的问题，例如什么物体突出或被遮挡、光线如何被阻挡、透射或反射、结构位于何处。机器人、监控系统与图像编辑器都建立在这些答案之上。我们研究可提示概念图，它将 SAM 3 的可提示概念分割从名词实例扩展到由简短名词短语命名的概念图，例如“透明物体”，并以“无”作为一种答案。PCM-Bench 按照各任务所问的问题，对七个此类任务的标准测试集进行了分组。在该基准上，我们发现 SAM 3 看到的比它检测到的更多：其语义路径对许多此类概念都有响应，但较低的图像级存在分数可能会阻断其实例路径的所有检测。我们提出 UNVEIL，它为这些概念图训练一份 SAM 3 语义路径的副本，并在其最后若干块的副本上使用 LoRA。一个独立的存在解码器从验证过的 n……
tldr: 论文发现 SAM 3 的语义路径能感知多种与类别无关的概念、但其存在分数会阻断实例检测，并提出 UNVEIL——通过 LoRA 微调 SAM 3 语义路径的副本并配合独立的存在解码器——实现超越类别的可提示概念图分割。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that SAM 3's semantic path perceives more class-agnostic concepts than its instance path detects due to presence-score gating, and proposes UNVEIL, which fine-tunes a copy of SAM 3's semantic path with LoRA plus a separate presence decoder to generate promptable concept maps beyond categories.
